references.text: Jacob named the place Bethel, but the former name of the city was Luz. This shows the original city of Luz after which the man from Bethel named his new city.
Jacob came to Luz in the land of Canaan, that is, Bethel. This confirms the connection between Luz and Bethel, which is relevant for the man's naming of the new city.
Jacob mentions that God revealed himself to him in Luz in the land of Canaan. This refers to the original Luz/Bethel after which the new city was named.
Luz is mentioned as a border city in Joshua's description of the territory of the tribe of Joseph. This shows the geographical location of the original Luz.
Luz, which is Bethel, is mentioned in the description of Benjamin's border. This confirms that Luz and Bethel were the same place in Canaan.
